# Tirupati Coolers

> Tirupati Coolers is a cooler company based in Surat, Gujarat, India. This website provides a product catalogue and direct WhatsApp enquiry path.

## Main page

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, searchable product range, selection guide, Google reviews, contact details, and map.

The public website is intentionally a single page. Catalogue, selection guidance, reviews, and contact information are available as sections on the homepage.

## Catalogue status

Product models, images, specifications, certifications, exact contact details, and performance claims are awaiting verification. The current catalogue uses clearly identified category previews and should not be treated as a final technical source.

## Contact

Location: Surat, Gujarat, India

The verified WhatsApp number and exact map location will be published before launch. Google reviews are retrieved from Google only when the required API credentials are configured.
